name: accessnexus
description: The missing schema layer for Supabase: define tables and access rules in TypeScript, get migrations, RLS policies, triggers, RPCs and a typed SDK. Built for AI coding agents.

scripts.build:binary: npm run build && bun build dist/cli/index.js --compile --outfile bin/accessnexus
scripts.build:binary:linux: npm run build && bun build dist/cli/index.js --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile bin/accessnexus-linux-x64
scripts.build:binary:mac: npm run build && bun build dist/cli/index.js --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile bin/accessnexus-darwin-arm64
scripts.build:binary:win: npm run build && bun build dist/cli/index.js --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile bin/accessnexus-win-x64.exe
scripts.generate:example: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js generate

author: AccessNexus <dev@accessnexus.dev>
